scope_notes: 398 files under src/pretalx (165 of them under */migrations/), 98 files under src/ outside the package (src/tests, src/manage.py, setup.py), 12 repo-root config files.

The nested pretalx-db CodeQL database directory is NOT part of the DB source scope (src.zip contains no pretalx-db entries); extraction queries additionally apply a structural src/pretalx/% scope guard so code traversal, search and candidate extraction exclude pretalx-db, src/tests and */migrations/ regardless of DB scope.

Django framework sources are NOT included in the DB; framework API calls (FileResponse, FileSystemStorage, serializers) resolve only by name at call sites, so extraction uses syntactic name matching with module hints.

No safe_join, get_valid_filename, basename, abspath, normpath, realpath or relative_to containment guards exist anywhere in pretalx's own source (grep-verified); the only name validation is Django-internal (Storage.get_valid_name) plus path_with_hash's random suffix
untrusted_boundary_judgments: HTTP request fields (GET/POST/FILES/headers/COOKIES/path) and URL route variables: attacker-controlled - extracted as sources.
Form cleaned_data / files and cfp session data: request-derived (second-order) - extracted with caveats.

Environment variables and config files (PRETALX_CONFIG_FILE, PRETALX_DATA_DIR, pretalx.cfg): operator/deployment configuration - extracted only as boundary candidates with an explicit not-attacker-controlled caveat; config.py:155 open() of the env-named config file is recorded as a sink row.

Management-command CLI arguments and celery task arguments (export_schedule_html event slug, --zip): operator-internal, NOT extracted as sources; the export command's file writes remain sink rows because their paths are event/URL-derived.
Mail attachments (schedule/models/schedule.py:610-618, mail/models.py): in-memory dicts with serialized content, no filesystem paths.

MEDIA_URL files: served via django.conf.urls.static.static() only when settings.DEBUG (pretalx/urls.py:47) and by the operator's web server in production; pretalx itself defines no media-serving view.
not_observed: No zipfile.ZipFile, tarfile, extractall or any archive extraction anywhere in pretalx source; the only archive API is shutil.make_archive (creation, CLI export).
No os.remove/os.replace/os.rename/os.unlink/os.listdir/os.makedirs calls in pretalx code (filesystem mutation goes through pathlib methods and Django storage).
No io.open / os.open; builtins open() only.
No shutil.move / shutil.copy* / tempfile.mkdtemp usage; tempfile usage is limited to NamedTemporaryFile (orga/views/cards.py:122) and TemporaryDirectory in test settings.
No os.path.join outside common/utils.py path_with_hash; no os.path.abspath/normpath/realpath.
No static-resource server beyond get_static (single sw.js route with a literal path).
coverage_gaps_and_caveats: Django framework internals are outside the DB, so FileResponse/FileSystemStorage/serializer semantics are matched syntactically by name with module hints; dynamic dispatch (default_storage, file_storage) is constrained by receiver naming, which can miss aliased storages.

Method-call file access with no positional path argument is not extracted as a sink family: SECRET_FILE.open()/SECRET_FILE.open(mode='w') (settings.py:167-173, operator-configured path) and FieldFile.read() of operator-configured event settings (agenda/views/widget.py:287,302, existing_file.read()) are recorded here instead.

QuerySet .delete()/.exists() noise makes generic .delete()/.exists()/.read() method families unusable; storage deletes are captured via the explicit default_storage receiver constraint, FieldCleanupMixin's value.delete(save=False) (common/mixins/models.py:102-103) is recorded here as a gap.

self.kwargs route variables are extracted for CBVs, but DRF serializer fields (api/serializers/) are not separately extracted; only validated_data reads (api/views/question.py:92,96) are covered via the form_cleaned_data family.
The get_static URL-boundary is currently only reachable with a literal path; flagged in row context rather than dropped, since plugin urlconfigs can add routes.

Management command export writes (dump_content/get_mediastatic_content) keep sink rows with CLI/event-derived path context; their trigger is the orga web UI via celery (ScheduleExportTriggerView -> export_schedule_html task) or the CLI, both operator-initiated.
exclusions_applied: pretalx-db/** (nested CodeQL database; structurally outside the src/pretalx/% scope guard)
